description: Operator guardrails for the gateway. Can only TIGHTEN the code locks and the GATEWAY_MAX_* deployment limits; anything looser is refused at start-up. verbs: allow|ask|deny per verb (allow only where the code needs no approval). limits: maxIterations, maxLlmCalls, maxToolCalls, maxPromptTokens, maxCompletionTokens, maxTotalTokens, maxCostUsd per run. Env GATEWAY_VERB_POLICY and GATEWAY_GUARDRAIL_MAX_* can tighten this file further. Shipped empty: no extra restriction.
